  Pre-Closing Checklist Call (T-3 business days):
  1. Confirm all regulatory clearances obtained / waiting periods expired
  2. Confirm all third-party consents received (or waiver of condition agreed)
  3. Walk all open items on closing checklist; assign owners and deadlines
  4. Confirm bring-down certificate drafts circulated and reviewed
  5. Confirm funds flow memorandum finalized; wire instructions verified
  6. Confirm escrow agreement signed; escrow agent ready to receive funds
  7. Confirm all closing deliverables in virtual data room (VDR) or escrow folder
  8. Confirm no MAE / bring-down failure; no new disclosed matter
  9. Identify any conditions to be waived; confirm waiver authority and documentation
  10. Confirm closing date, time, and jurisdiction

  Closing Day Protocol:
  1. Confirm electronic signatures (DocuSign or equivalent) collected for all documents
  2. Release of documents from escrow — simultaneous release only (no unilateral release)
  3. Wire confirmation received — funds in transit confirmation from Buyer's bank
  4. Payoff letters — confirm receipt of funds by each lender; obtain payoff confirmation
  5. Lien release instructions delivered to UCC filing agent
  6. Cap table / stock ledger updated
  7. Regulatory closing notices dispatched
  8. Closing memorandum circulated to all parties confirming Closing has occurred
